_comment: PaperDrop configuration. Paths are user-scoped; ~ expands.
_comment_source: mode=manifest reads a JSON manifest (recommended: it carries a sha256, so an unchanged image is never re-downloaded). mode=image treats the URL as a plain always-updated image and has NO manifest consistency guarantee.
_comment_paths: Where the current and previous image are cached.
_comment_http: max_bytes caps a single download; retries apply only to transient failures (timeouts, 429, 5xx).
_comment_apply: scaling=fill keeps the aspect ratio and fills the screen. helper_path is the compiled macOS helper (leave empty to auto-detect). xfce_image_style stays null to preserve whatever background style you configured in Xfce.
_comment_schedule: Used by the installer to create the user-level schedule.
